description:
Cruiser Style

Designed with a laid-back cruiser style, this bicycle offers an upright riding position that promotes comfort and relaxation, making it ideal for city commuting and beach trips

Low-Step-Through Design

Allows riders to easily get on and off the bike, uitable for a wide range of riders, including those in skirts or dresses, and individuals with shorter inseams

Quality Tires

Adult beach cruiser bikes feature 26-inch wheels for excellent roll and a cushioned, stable ride, making a lady's daily commute in the city more energy efficient and faster

Shifting and Braking

The V-brake system ensures efficient and responsive braking performance, a 7-speed gear system provides sufficient flexibility to handle various riding conditions

Purchase Guide

85% pre-assembled, just need to install the wheel, handle bar, seat and pedals; Just need 5 to 10 minutes to finish; 26'' bicycle for men and women height of 5'5" to 6'

About Us

HILAND had a simple yet powerful mission — to bring the joy of cycling and a healthy, positive lifestyle to everyone. From the very beginning, HILAND set out to provide affordable, high-quality bicycles that would make the freedom of riding accessible to all.

We've got our own manufacturing facilities, so we ensure that each bike we make brings top-notch performance and affordability to our amazing customers.

Ride in style with the Hiland Flare Cruiser Bike. Featuring a classic step-through frame, single-speed simplicity, and dual-braking for a comfortable, smooth ride.
